run_visualise_pipeline: run the visualisation pipeline on a bundle adjustment pickle file to render SMPL mesh overlays
visualize_smpl_mesh: visualize SMPL mesh rendered overlays with rotated views on a video frame
transform_keypoints_to_image: transform keypoints from normalized range to image pixel coordinates
parse_filename: parse a pickle filename to extract video id, start time, and end time
video_from_images: create a video from a directory of rendered images using ffmpeg
